from.place: proof, induction step: descend an associated prime from the localization using finite generation, as in Algebra Lemma 10.66.9

title: A finitely generated prime associated after localization is associated before localization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, M an R-module, and p a finitely generated prime ideal of R. Let R_p and M_p denote localization at p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. If the maximal ideal of the local ring R_p is the annihilator of an element of the localized module M_p, then p is the annihilator of an element of M.
